label: omnitruck.chef.io install script
msg: Installs Chef's own build; Chef Infra Client 15 and later stop until the Chef licence is accepted
fix: https://omnitruck.cinc.sh/install.sh (install.ps1 on Windows), the Apache-2.0 Cinc build of the same source

label: --chef-license accept
msg: Accepts the Chef licence on this node (Chef Infra Client 15+ licence gate)
fix: drop the flag after switching to Cinc Client; Cinc is not a licensed product and asks for no acceptance

label: CHEF_LICENSE=accept
msg: CHEF_LICENSE environment variable accepts the Chef licence for every Chef binary in this shell or job
fix: remove CHEF_LICENSE once the job installs Cinc Client, Cinc Workstation or Cinc Auditor

label: chef_license 'accept'
msg: chef_license in client.rb, config.rb or kitchen.yml accepts the Chef licence
fix: delete the chef_license line and install Cinc Client; in kitchen.yml set product_name: cinc

label: product_name: chef
msg: Test Kitchen installs Chef Infra Client and runs the licence check on every converge
fix: product_name: cinc (Test Kitchen skips licence acceptance for Cinc)

label: chef/chef image
msg: Chef-published container image ships the licensed Chef binaries
fix: build from your base image and install Cinc from https://omnitruck.cinc.sh/install.sh

label: package install of chef
msg: Package or gem install of Chef's licensed Chef, Workstation or InSpec build
fix: install cinc, cinc-workstation or cinc-auditor instead; the chef-client, chef and inspec wrappers keep old scripts working

label: actionshub/chef-install
msg: CI step installs Chef Workstation from Chef, so the job must accept the Chef licence
fix: run curl -L https://omnitruck.cinc.sh/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- -P cinc-workstation

label: knife bootstrap (default installer)
msg: knife bootstrap without --bootstrap-url installs Chef Infra Client from Chef on the new node

label: /opt/chef path
msg: Hard-coded /opt/chef path; Cinc packages install under /opt/cinc
fix: /opt/cinc (or call chef-client from PATH and let the Cinc wrapper resolve it)

label: chef-server-ctl
fix: move to Cinc Server with a knife-ec-backup backup and restore; nodes re-attach when the FQDN is unchanged

eol.after: the open-source Chef Infra Server reached end of life on 2026-11-30 ({days} days ago)
